text:
Maya: heads-up — deploybot sweep just flagged a steady p95 increase on embeddings in eu-west-1. canary cohort at 40% and rising. watching for 5m, but we should prepare rollback path.
DeployBot: automated-sweep: embeddings/predict service | region=eu-west-1 | metric=p95_latency | change=+32% | window=3m | action_suggest=HOLD_IF_NOT_STABLE -> AUTO-ROLLBACK_THRESHOLD=180s
Ash: on it, checking logs & recent kernel flags. could be KV cache warmup but 32% is above our safety envelope.
Maya: agree. if it doesn't come down in 3m we should do manual rollback to last known-good (v2.3.9) and pin. prefer manual to avoid noisy flapping.
Rob: pinging sales to surface to the handful of customers on dedicated pools in eu-west-1 — will DM the account owners.
Olivia: I'll draft a one-paragraph customer note and support template in #support. short: "we've detected a latency regression and are rolling back a canary; brief interruption possible".
Maya: rollback command ready, leaving here for ops approval. snippet:```bash
./infractl rollback --service=inference-api --version=v2.3.9 --scope=canary --region=eu-west-1
```
DeployBot: note: automated rollback will trigger at 180s if p95 stays > +25%. manual rollback accepted; will suppress auto-action on manual trigger.
Ash: logs show a spike correlated with a kernel flag keysize change from recent build. preparing a quick revert patch but that's longer than a rollback.
Maya: proceeding with manual rollback in 30s unless objections. Rob/Olivia, please hold support comms until rollback completes then post.
Rob: no objections. go ahead. I'll update sales after rollback completion.
PagerDuty: INCIDENT #6421 opened for eu-west-1 embeddings latency regression. severity=sev3. assigned=Ash.
Olivia: drafting support note now, will paste into #support in 45s. short release note (for internal release-notes channel): "Canary rollback: embeddings service v2.3.10 -> v2.3.9 due to p95 latency regression in eu-west-1. Customers on dedicated pools unaffected unless traffic routed to canary cohort."
Ash: rollback executed: confirmed traffic shifted back to v2.3.9 for EU canary slice at 4765432160. p95 trending down.
DeployBot: rollback-complete: all canary pods on v2.3.9 | region=eu-west-1 | p95_delta=-18% after 30s | auto-rollback-suppressed=true
Maya: nice. pin request: please pin canary selector to v2.3.9 until root cause triage done.
DeployBot: pin applied: canary selector -> v2.3.9. will block auto-rollout of v2.3.10 until manual unblock.
Olivia: posted support template and customer note in #support; copying sales DM to Rob.
Rob: got it. emailing affected AEs + logging in CRM.
Maya: next steps: Ash to continue RCA for kernel flag interaction, infra team to validate rollback migration plan for stable rollout later. thanks everyone, closing thread once RCA ticket is created.
Ash: creating RCA ticket now (RCA-2026). will link tests and perf diffs.
Maya: closing loop — remind on-call to leave deploy window open for 1h for monitoring. :thumbsup:
